name: Dark Platform Hero
purpose: Introduce a technical platform with product proof and depth.
compositionNotes: Use actual product/data signals, not generic sci-fi decoration.

name: Architecture Diagram
compositionNotes: Use when PRD includes APIs, pipelines, models, or data flow.

name: Live Metrics Console
purpose: Show operational credibility through live-looking metrics.
compositionNotes: Use plausible values and semantic status colors.

name: Capability Orbit
purpose: Visualize connected capabilities around a core platform.
compositionNotes: Keep labels readable; avoid random decorative nodes.

name: Security Trust Grid
purpose: Handle trust, compliance, and resilience claims.
compositionNotes: Use restrained visuals and strong contrast.

name: Developer Code Demo
purpose: Show developer experience with code and result preview.
compositionNotes: Use monospaced code and realistic snippets.

name: Technical Use Case Cards
purpose: Translate platform capability into concrete use cases.
compositionNotes: Use after technical architecture or hero.

name: Technical Final CTA
purpose: Close with demo, docs, trial, or contact action.
compositionNotes: Offer docs or sandbox as secondary action.
